title: Filee: free CloudConvert alternative
caption:
CloudConvert charges $8/month. Filee does the same job for free 🔄

✅ Hold a key, drag files, drop them on a format at your cursor
✅ 246 formats: images, PDF, Word, Excel, video, audio, e-books
✅ Nothing uploaded, works offline on your computer
✅ No subscription, no tracking, 100% free

Comment "FILE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
